title: This page isn’t available right now.
lede: We couldn’t load the information needed for this page.
supporting: Retry the request. If the problem continues, return to the RFxchange homepage and try again later.
loadingBody: RFxchange is loading the current information for this page.
notFoundBody: The address may have changed, or this page may no longer be available.
globalBody: Retry the request. If the problem continues, return to the RFxchange homepage and try again later.
accountTitle: Your account does not currently have active organization access.
accountBody: Your previous organization membership is no longer active, so that organization’s workspace is no longer available to this account.
accountNext: Use a current organization invitation to regain access, or sign out and return when an organization administrator has restored or invited your account.
organizationTitle: Choose the active organization you want to use.
organizationBody: Your previous setup belongs to a different organization and will not be transferred automatically.
organizationBoundary: Choosing an organization here selects the membership you want to use. It does not transfer another organization’s setup or permissions.
